verses.text: Jethro, Midian’s priest and Moses’ father-in-law, heard how God had helped Moses and Israel, and how Yahweh brought Israel out of Egypt. 📨
After Moses had sent his wife away, Jethro brought Zipporah back to him, 💍
along with their two sons. One son was named Gershom, because Moses said, ‘I’ve been a foreigner in a foreign land.’ 👨‍👩‍👦
The other was named Eliezer, because Moses said, ‘My father’s God helped me and rescued me from Pharaoh’s sword.’ 🛡️
Jethro came to Moses in the wilderness where he was camped near God’s mountain. He brought Moses’ wife and sons with him. 🏕️
He sent word to Moses: ‘I, Jethro your father-in-law, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons.’ 📨
Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, bowed, and kissed him. They asked how each other was doing, then went into the tent. 🤝
Moses told Jethro everything Yahweh had done to Pharaoh and Egypt for Israel, all the hardships they faced on the way, and how Yahweh rescued them. 🗣️
Jethro was glad to hear all the good Yahweh had done for Israel by rescuing them from Egypt. 🙌
Jethro said, ‘Blessed be Yahweh! He rescued you from Egypt and Pharaoh, and pulled his people out from under Egypt’s power. 🙏
‘Now I know Yahweh is greater than all gods, because he rescued people from those who treated them arrogantly.’ ✨
Jethro brought a burnt offering and other sacrifices for God. Aaron and all Israel’s elders came to eat a meal with Moses’ father-in-law before God. 🍽️
The next day, Moses sat down to settle the people’s disputes. They stood around him from morning until evening. ⚖️
When Jethro saw everything Moses was doing for the people, he asked, ‘Why are you doing this all by yourself, while everyone stands around from morning to evening?’ 😮
Moses answered his father-in-law, ‘The people come to me to ask God what to do. 🙏
‘When they have a dispute, they bring it to me. I decide between one person and another, and explain God’s rules and instructions to them.’ ⚖️
Jethro said, ‘The way you’re handling this isn’t good. ⚠️
‘You’ll wear yourself out, and the people with you too. This job is too heavy to carry alone. 😓
‘Listen to my advice, and may God be with you. You should represent the people before God and bring their cases to him. 🤝
‘Teach them God’s rules and instructions. Show them the way to live and the work they should do. 📜
‘Also choose capable people from among the people—people who respect God, tell the truth, and reject dishonest gain. Put them in charge of thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens. 👥
‘Let them judge the people regularly. They can handle smaller cases themselves, but bring every major case to you. That will make your load lighter, because they’ll carry it with you. ⚖️
‘If you do this and God approves, you’ll be able to keep going, and everyone can return home in peace.’ 🕊️
Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he advised. 👂
Moses chose capable men from all Israel and put them in charge of thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens. 👥
They judged the people regularly. They brought the difficult cases to Moses and handled the smaller ones themselves. ⚖️
Then Moses said goodbye to his father-in-law, and Jethro went back to his own land. 🧳
